seoTitle: Word Counter with Reading and Speaking Estimates
metaDescription: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs as you edit your text in the browser.
intro: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs as you edit your text in the browser.
aboutTitle: How does the word counter calculate reading time?
about: Reading time is estimated at 200 words per minute and speaking time at 130. The tool splits words at whitespace, so counts can differ from editors that use other rules.
example: Paste a 400-word draft. The reading estimate is about two minutes. Use the character counts when you have a separate space limit.

faqs.question: Can I see the character count without spaces?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool displays the total character count and a separate count that excludes whitespace.
